title: get_latest_trading_signals
description: Test the GET /api/signals endpoint to ensure it retrieves the 10 most recent trading signals ordered by timestamp, returns a 200 status on success, and handles server errors with a 500 status.

title: get_all_trade_journal_entries
description: Test the GET /api/journal endpoint to verify it returns all trade journal entries ordered by entry date descending, responds with 200 on success, and handles server errors with a 500 status.

title: create_new_trade_journal_entry_with_validation
description: Test the POST /api/journal endpoint to create a new trade journal entry with required fields (symbol, direction, entry_price, size), validate input data, return 200 on successful creation, 400 on validation errors, and 500 on server errors.

title: receive_and_process_tradingview_webhook_alerts
description: Test the POST /api/webhook/tradingview endpoint to receive TradingView alerts with secret authentication, validate required fields (symbol, action), process the webhook correctly, return 200 on success, 400 on invalid requests, 401 on unauthorized access, and 500 on server errors.

title: get_killswitch_status
description: Test the GET /api/killswitch endpoint to retrieve the current KillSwitch status, ensuring it returns 200 on success and 500 on error.

title: trigger_and_reset_killswitch
description: Test the POST /api/killswitch endpoint to trigger or reset the KillSwitch with valid actions ('trigger', 'reset'), validate input, return 200 on success, 400 on invalid action, and 500 on server errors.

title: get_all_autonomous_trading_agents
description: Test the GET /api/agents endpoint to retrieve all autonomous trading agents, ensuring a 200 response on success and 500 on error.

title: create_new_autonomous_trading_agent
description: Test the POST /api/agents endpoint to create a new autonomous trading agent with optional fields (name, market, strategy), verify successful creation with 200 response, and handle server errors with 500.
